notes:
The branch already had a draft of all four objects and both test classes, so the Tester's suite passed on the first run_tests (19 passed). It did not start from failing tests. The draft already matched the amended DES-001 and the 2026-10-26 answers: dim_payment_method.load_id is bigint and holds etl_run_log.log_id; the eight seed rows are in src/sql/seed/MOD-003 (explicit ids 0, -1, -2 and 1 to 5 inserted with IDENTITY_INSERT, so the identity continues from 6), and the down script deletes exactly those ids; fn_map_payment_method trims surrounding spaces and ignores case. Choices the suite does not fix, each covered in test_MOD003_dev: (1) fn_map_payment_method reads source_code from silv_ref_payment_method, so a method added later maps without a code change. It never matches a reserved row (id <= 0). It trims only spaces: a tab, a line break or a space inside the code gives -1. (2) usp_load_dim_payment_method compares names as bytes, so a change in case or trailing spaces is updated. It sets load_id and updated_at only on rows it inserts or updates, and keeps created_at. It never deletes: a dimension id no longer in silver stays (rows_deleted is always 0), because facts may still point at it. The update and insert run in one transaction, so a failure also rolls back an update already made. The error message records the error number. No grants: the design asks for no access to these objects.

Test-first: the first run had 13 of 13 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 13 of 13 and 6 unit test(s), in 1 run(s).
